title: Verify, request the exact human action, then resume
when: A declared site is signed out or an exploratory mission hits auth
need: Verify first; authorize opens only expired sites. Human supplies personal credentials; unreachable probes need technical repair. Sign-in pauses automated browsers on that machine until windows close. From the connected workstation, --machine reads declarations and opens sign-in on the registered Test Machine GUI, without a control-plane connection there. Unrouted hosts still receive nonsecret declarations locally; live identity store survives reset. Required desktop-browser extension: browser authorize must also check Test Machine Linux Chromium and macOS Safari sign-ins, open only expired sites, name the account, and keep desktop sign-ins live through reset outside goldens. Landed source includes automation plus native desktop by default with --machine, with no desktop opt-out. Standalone --desktop-browser checks only native local; without --machine existing local automation is unchanged. Real-host sign-in/reset and released delivery proof remain pending.
surface: Installed browser identities reference and authorize help; successor Pack Linux procedure and macOS entry pointer to the complete browser-identities procedure.
gap: The successor repairs portable installed references and per-OS audience boundaries in source. Final default desktop inclusion is merged with full-gate evidence; released-target, actual receiving and real authorize/reset/sign-in proof remain pending.
review: Remote command, lease ownership, settings validation, quoting, OS GUI helpers and post-window outcome forwarding have source regression tests; live operator sign-in proof remains pending. Source-only successor documentation preserves all six macOS identity steps in browser-identities.md and keeps a mandatory macOS entry link. Historical Linux reset correction 5a4b84c0d7565f38cc2308df25950fd76d4fef0e had producer-reported 29 targeted PASS, CI run 39040788218 PASS and QA requirement 50631 artifact 36759; its implementation is present in the final landed source, while real reset/released proof remains pending. Historical candidate 31b0cfaf30d303c729d936d49e178fa65e6faeed failed full CI run 39042681883 on an unchanged automation-only remote consumer. Superseded opt-in source e2dc611a21d52f4e192d7e18eb3804d8dd45c5d3 passed full CI run 39044050221; that passing opt-in contract is not the final landed default-inclusion behavior. Final source landed at merge 9768e3e8e225ed4120d2251eac4587ea6aa4ddd0, whose source parent is 6fd8127f13e7e3fa3779d9d3ca7647881dac46d7. Its verified browser_authorize_help.py and routing include selected automation plus native Linux snap Chromium/macOS Safari by default with --machine, using declared sites/accounts, headless native cookies, expired-only tabs and named accounts; unreadable cookies/unreachable probes refuse before tabs. No remote desktop opt-out exists. Without --machine local automation stays unchanged; standalone --desktop-browser checks native local only. Desktop reset refuses and remote --reset affects only automation. Producer full CI run 39045367272 PASS on exact source 6fd8127f13e7e3fa3779d9d3ca7647881dac46d7, QA requirement 50674 artifact 36808, followed one steering-authorized unchanged-index-flake rerun with the original failure retained. This is merged source/full-gate evidence, not released delivery or actual authorize/reset/live proof; those remain pending.
